slides.title: Bolt in the fog
slides.text: In the fog, Bolt cannot see the walls. A plain list of moves would bump into one. Bolt needs to decide for itself.
slides.alt: Fog covers Bolt's board: only the squares near Bolt can be seen, so no fixed list of steps could work here.

focus.cue: Bolt can only see the squares right around him.
The rest is fog: walls could hide anywhere.

slides.title: An if asks a question
slides.text: An if block asks a question about right now: is the path ahead clear? If yes, one thing happens. If no, the else part happens.
slides.alt: One if / else block in the tray: if path ahead, move; else, turn left. Bolt checks and picks a side every time it runs.

focus.cue: If the path ahead is clear, Bolt moves.
Else — no clear path — Bolt turns left instead.

slides.title: A fog-proof program
slides.text: Put an if / else inside a repeat. Bolt checks again at every square, so he turns by himself when the way ahead is blocked.
slides.alt: The repeat until goal program with the if / else inside it, feeling its way along the open path across a board of water.

focus.cue: Path ahead clear? Move. Bolt drives along the open row.
Water ahead: no path, so the else turns Bolt left.
Then the path is clear again, all the way to the goal.

slides.title: A when listens
slides.text: A when block waits for something to happen, like a gem being picked up. Then its blocks run right away. An if asks; a when listens.
slides.alt: A when block waits at the top of the program: when a gem is picked up, turn right, with the driving loop underneath it.

focus.cue: The when block waits at the top, listening.
The moment a gem is picked up, Bolt turns right.
In the loop below, if on a gem, pick up: each pick-up sets the when off.

words.means: a question with a yes or no answer
a block that runs its steps only when the answer is yes
the steps that run when the answer is no
something that happens, like a gem being picked up

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Robo Route at Conditionals & events and finish all 7 levels. Say each rule out loud first: if ___, then Bolt ___.
slides.alt: Fog covers Bolt's board: only the squares near Bolt can be seen, so no fixed list of steps could work here.

focus.cue: Your turn: say the rule out loud first — if, then.
